chunks: Yet their hearts are oblivious of this; and besides, they are busy with other things, they are workers for them.

key_terms.دُونِ: besides, other than, or separate from
key_terms.غَمْرَةٍ: oblivion, confusion, or deep covering of the heart

ai.seo_question: What does it mean that the hearts are in 'ghamrah' (oblivion/confusion)?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the spiritual blindness of the disbelievers, whose hearts are enveloped in 'ghamrah' (a deep, murky ignorance) regarding the Quranic message. While they diligently perform their worldly deeds, these actions are disconnected from divine truth, rendering them spiritually futile. This condition underscores the necessity of not just action, but action rooted in correct belief and understanding.
